summary: Wooden municipal fire tower on Tower Mountain, staffed 1930-1942; now a former site, and a June hike report says a fire tower once stood there.

facts.status_note: Listed as a former lookout site; a hiking group's June report says a fire tower once stood on Tower Mountain.

visit.trail_note: Tower Mountain is one of the features listed on the Taconic Crest Trail, which passes through Pittsfield State Forest.

events.note: Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 3, 2008.

notes_for_editor: Only FFLOS describes the tower itself. No build date, reason for construction, or removal date appears in any source read. The Facebook hike post is a hiking group's report, not a survey, and says only that a fire tower once stood on Tower Mountain. Access level is left out: no source says whether the former site is open to visitors. Brief record (gone, 2,193 ft / 668 m, 2008 registration, coordinates) checks out against FFLOS; no corrections proposed.
